title: A server holds a workspace per project
body:
A decade server holds every workspace (see the note on decade-da02e3). A workspace is a project, with its own split tree and default cwd. Today decade has one `Layout` with one tree.

## Proposal

The server keeps several workspaces. A viewer shows one, and switches between them with a key and from the palette. A pane started in a workspace starts in its cwd.
